fixed_contract.candidate_policy: every physical page within the report, including attachments and blank/failed pages

fixed_contract.answer_token_and_image_budgets: separate protocol settings; not implemented by native retrieval

decision_basis.note_format_primary_paired_gains_and_reg: 0 gains, 0 regressions against both controls; all 24 annotated top-five sets unchanged

decision_basis.reason: same primary/complete coverage at the fixed page budget, simpler matched representation control and no heading ingestion dependency; small development cohort does not establish held-out superiority
